source.title: Main Course
source.description:
No meal is truly complete without the star of the dish - the meat! As you can probably imagine, hunting for meat that is safe to consume in the Plaguelands is a challenge unlike no other.

To make matters worse, our hounds eat nothing but meat! I am sure you can see where this is going, and I am sure by now you understand why I am perpetually behind.

Well? What are you waiting for?
source.objective: Acquire meat that is safe for human consumption. If you struggle to locate some in New Avalon, you may (eventually) gather enough from slaying beasts in the Eastern Plaguelands.
source.progress: Back already? That can't be good.
source.completion:
Your expedience is appreciated and suspicious; almost as suspicious as the coloration of these hunks of meat. Fortunately we have all built up strong stomachs during our time out here.

A few cuts here, a dash of spices there, and no one will be the wiser.

These will suffice, hopefully. Thank you.
